bundled_adapted_checkpoint.format: PyTorch dictionary containing the two adapted projection module state dictionaries

architecture: HTDemucs 6-source matched-reference gain-response with task-adapted final output projections
channel_convention: mono asset mixture duplicated to dual-mono model input
amplitude_convention: matched reference/observation scale is preserved; no independent normalization
comparison_regime: matched real-recorded MoisesDB digital excerpts with deterministic controlled gain interventions
tested_data_regime: CP2B artist-isolated calibration and 16-parent/10-artist untouched fresh-final digital benchmark
tested_noise_regime: selective validation-only MUSAN ambient/babble/speech at 20 and 10 dB observation SNR; no common 10 dB passing envelope
calibration_status: Family-specific thresholds were frozen before fresh-final access; only bass survived all fresh-final targets.
